checks: Fixed source, executable, driver and artifact hashes
All accepted prescribed step sizes and successful Newton/Krylov reasons
Each logged original-operator norm against the unchanged applicable linear gate
Each final physical and constraint gate against the configured tolerance
Every accepted-step and final fluid/solid volume VTU field and coordinate vs direct
Volume node identity, ownership, connectivity and cell identifiers
Ghost fields vs owners, final output vs final accepted step
Every CSV physical column except the intentionally variable Newton iteration count
Native FP32 final coefficient/patch storage across ranks
Hierarchy transfer reproduction/energy and actual cumulative V/K work counters
Fine aggregate pressure pairs and FP64 setup coupling preservation; no global inf-sup claim
